model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average percentages of Welt-BIP, Welthandel, and Industrie Produktion Deutschland across three time periods: 2000er Jahre, 2010er Jahre, and 2020er Jahre. The horizontal axis displays the years, starting with 2000er Jahre at the left and progressing to 2020er Jahre at the right. The vertical axis represents percentages, ranging from -2.0% to 6.0%, with a linear scale and tick intervals of 0.5%. The blue bars represent the percentage of “Exporte Deutschland,” with a maximum value of 5.0% and a minimum value of 3.7%. The green bars represent the percentage of “Welthandel,” with a maximum value of 5.4% and a minimum value of 2.3%. The light gray bars represent the percentage of “Industrie Produktion Deutschland,” with a maximum value of 4.8% and a minimum value of -1.5%. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.
